samples.questionText:
Find the missing value in the ratio table:

x | y
1 | 2
3 | 6
6 | ?

Find the missing value in the ratio table:

$$\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{x} & \text{y} \\ \hline
1 & 2 \\
3 & 6 \\
6 & ?
\end{array}$$
solutionSteps: Find the constant of proportionality: y/x = 2/1 = 2.
